# HALLE Clock-In System: Data Dictionary

This data dictionary defines the data fields used to submit, validate, and resolve an employee clock-in request, from submission through manager review.

**Category key:** User-entered = typed or selected by a person. Derived = looked up or calculated from other data. System-assigned = generated by the system.

| Field | Business Meaning | Type | Required? | Category | Rule / Constraint | Source | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **requestId** | Unique identifier assigned to each clock-in request so the request can be tracked through every state. | Text | Yes | System-assigned | Must be unique; generated by the system at submission; never changes once assigned | System | REQ-10025 |
| **employeeId** | Identifier the employee enters to submit a clock-in request. | Text | Yes | User-entered | Must use the format EMP- followed by 5 digits; must match an existing employee record, otherwise the request is Rejected ("Employee ID not found.") | Employee | EMP-10492 |
| **department** | Department the employee is clocking in for. | Dropdown | Yes | User-entered | Must select one: Grocery, Produce, Prepared Foods, Front End; must match the department on the employee's record, otherwise the request is Rejected ("Department does not match employee record.") | Employee | Grocery |
| **scheduledShiftStart** | Time the employee is scheduled to begin the shift. | Time | Yes | User-entered | Entered on the form as HH:MM; used to calculate minutesFromShiftStart | Employee | 8:00 AM |
| **clockInComment** | Employee's explanation for clocking in more than 15 minutes early or late. | Text | Conditional | User-entered | Required when minutesFromShiftStart is less than -15 or greater than 15; optional otherwise; maximum 250 characters | Employee | Traffic delayed my arrival |
| **employeeName** | Name of the employee associated with the employee ID. | Text | Yes | Derived | Retrieved from the employee record using employeeId; not manually entered | Employee record | Jen Calderon |
| **employmentStatus** | Indicates whether the employee is currently employed and eligible to clock in. | Text | Yes | Derived | Allowed: Active, Inactive; Inactive causes the request to be Rejected ("Employee is not active and cannot clock in.") | Employee record | Active |
| **scheduledShiftDate** | Date of the shift the employee is clocking in for. | Date | Yes | System-assigned | Set to the current date (Central time) when the request is submitted | System | 11/02/2026 |
| **clockInTimestamp** | Date and time the clock-in request is recorded. | Date/Time | Yes | System-assigned | Set by the backend from the system clock (Central time) when the request is received; shown read-only on the form; cannot be entered or changed by the employee | System | 11/02/2026 8:04 AM |
| **minutesFromShiftStart** | Difference in minutes between the clock-in time and the scheduled shift start. | Integer | Yes | Derived | Calculated as clockInTimestamp minus scheduledShiftStart, compared at the minute level (seconds ignored). Negative = early, positive = late. Exactly 15 is within the window. Less than -15 or greater than 15 with a comment causes the request to be Flagged; without a comment it is Rejected | System calculation | 4 |
| **hasOpenClockIn** | Indicates whether the employee already has an open clock-in that would create a duplicate or overlapping shift. | Boolean | Yes | Derived | Allowed: True, False; True causes the request to be Rejected ("Employee already has an open clock-in.") | Clock-in records | False |
| **clockInStatus** | Current state of the clock-in request. | Text | Yes | System-assigned | Allowed: Submitted, Under Review, Accepted, Flagged, Rejected, Resolved; changes only through allowed state transitions | System | Accepted |
| **statusReason** | Explains why a request was Flagged or Rejected. | Text | Conditional | System-assigned | Required when clockInStatus is Flagged or Rejected | System | Clock-in more than 15 minutes late |
| **reviewedBy** | Manager who reviewed a Flagged or Rejected request. | Text | Conditional | System-assigned | Required when clockInStatus is Resolved; must be a valid manager ID; captured from the logged-in manager | System | MGR-2041 |
| **managerDecision** | Outcome of the manager's review. | Text | Conditional | User-entered (manager) | Allowed: Approved, Denied; required when clockInStatus is Resolved | Manager | Approved |
| **resolutionNote** | Manager's explanation for the review decision. | Text | Conditional | User-entered (manager) | Required when clockInStatus is Resolved | Manager | Late arrival due to approved schedule change |
| **resolvedAt** | Date and time the manager completed the review. | Date/Time | Conditional | System-assigned | Required when clockInStatus is Resolved; recorded from the system clock; must be later than clockInTimestamp | System | 11/02/2026 9:30 AM |

## Notes

- **Authoritative rules:** Employee ID format, department matching, employment status, duplicate detection, the 15-minute window, and the comment requirement are enforced in the backend (AWS Lambda), not only in the browser. The browser checks required fields first so the employee gets quick feedback.

- **Rule order:** The backend checks rules in this order and stops at the first failure: required fields and format, employee found, employee active, department match, open clock-in, 15-minute window and comment.

- **Comment rule:** A clock-in more than 15 minutes early or late needs a clockInComment. With a comment the request is Flagged for manager review; without one it is Rejected and the employee can resubmit with a comment.

- **Audit requirement:** Every Flagged or Rejected request must record reviewedBy, managerDecision, resolutionNote, and resolvedAt before it can move to Resolved. Manager review is part of the design and is not built in the current checkpoint.

- **Timestamps:** clockInTimestamp, scheduledShiftDate, and resolvedAt come only from the system clock so records cannot be backdated. All times use Central time (America/Chicago).

- **Data source for this checkpoint:** Employee records (employeeName, employmentStatus, department) and clock-in records (hasOpenClockIn) are mock data inside the Lambda function. They will move to DynamoDB in the next stage.
